title: Claim
description: One evidenced, decision-bearing statement extracted from one chunk of one source. `condition` and `consequence` are required because they are exactly what a summarising pass cannot populate honestly: a summary describes what the text covers, a claim states what changes under what circumstances.

id.description: <source-slug>/chNN/sNN/cNN by default; the shape is configurable in .distill.json and read by nothing else.

unit.description: The manifest row this claim belongs to. A claim pointing at a unit the manifest lacks means the denominator and the store disagree.

chunk.description: The chunk actually read. Optional for stores predating the ingestion tier.

condition.description: When this holds. A `rule` claim whose condition is 'always' is a platitude: it passes every gate and changes no decision.

mentions.description: defines minus mentions is the completeness signal: a concept referenced by some claim and defined by none is either a miss or a forward reference.

excerpt_hash.description: A real digest over the exact span read. A placeholder looks populated and proves nothing, which is how an evidence chain breaks invisibly.

origin.description: model-origin material is tagged, confidence-capped and kept in its own tier: repetition of a model inference is not corroboration of a fact.

confidence.description: Computed by rubric, never assigned by hand, so it can be recomputed when new corroboration arrives.

prompt_version.description: <stage>@<hash>. Editing the prompt invalidates work produced under the old one, automatically rather than by memory.
